mapper.sql: r.id, r.street_area_id, sa.name AS street_area_name, r.name, r.theme, r.estimated_duration, r.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experience_route_item i WHERE i.route_id = r.id) AS poi_count
FROM experience_route r LEFT JOIN street_area sa ON r.street_area_id = sa.id
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.street_area_id, sa.name AS street_area_name, r.name, r.theme, r.description, r.estimated_duration, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experience_route_item i WHERE i.route_id = r.id) AS poi_count FROM experience_route r LEFT JOIN street_area sa ON r.street_area_id = sa.id WHERE r.id=#{id}

SELECT i.sequence, i.recommendation_reason, p.id AS poi_id, p.name AS poi_name, p.poi_type AS poi_type, p.status AS poi_status, p.description AS poi_description, p.longitude, p.latitude, s.id AS store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.business_status AS store_business_status, CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') END AS store_cover_image_url FROM experience_route_item i JOIN poi p ON i.poi_id = p.id LEFT JOIN store s ON p.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON s.cover_image_file_id = sf.id WHERE i.route_id=#{routeId} ORDER BY i.sequence ASC
